name: Sequential stud torque procedure
text: Lubricate studs/nuts. Run nuts down by hand. Keep flange gap even. Pass 1: snug with combo wrench. Pass 2: firm with same wrench. Pass 3: 25% of recommended torque. Pass 4: 75%. Pass 5: 100%. Continue at 100% until no nut moves. Follow the numbered star sequence (8/12/16/20/24/28/32-stud patterns).
source_doc: Pocket Tradesman field book (owner's copy) — photo IMG_2336, transcribed by Claude from photo; NOT yet owner-verified

name: Torque star sequence rule
text: Number studs so each successive pair is diametrically opposite (1 and 2 opposite, 3 and 4 opposite at 90 deg, etc.), then proceed around; generate programmatically: for n studs, sequence i -> position (i*(n/2)) mod n pattern per ASME PCC-1 legacy star
